name: Moroccan Beauty Blue Nila Powder 50g | Skin Whitening, Anti-Inflammatory & Hydrating
description:
Moroccan Beauty Blue Nila Powder is a potent skincare ingredient designed to brighten, calm, and hydrate the skin. Rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties, it helps reduce redness, balance oil production, and accelerate the healing of blemishes. Suitable for all skin types, this versatile 50g powder can be mixed with oils, water, aloe vera, or natural bases like honey and yogurt for customized treatments, leaving your skin soft, smooth, and radiant.

Key Features
Anti-inflammatory: Calms redness, irritation, and inflammation
Antioxidant-rich: Protects skin from free radicals and environmental damage
Hydrating: Retains moisture for soft and supple skin
Balances oil production to reduce breakouts
Accelerates healing of minor blemishes and wounds
Versatile use with oils, water, or natural bases for customized masks

How to Use
Mix with carrier oils like jojoba, argan, or sweet almond oil for direct application
Combine with honey, yogurt, clay, or water to form a paste and apply to face
Massage gently in circular motions and leave 10–15 minutes before rinsing
Dab on blemishes or irritated areas overnight for healing
Add a pinch to moisturizer, serum, or toner for extra benefits
Always patch test before full application

Material
100% Blue Nila (Indigofera Tinctoria) powder, natural herbal formulation

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Do a patch test before use
Use sparingly; may stain if over-applied
Keep out of reach of children

Package Includes
1 × 50g Moroccan Beauty Blue Nila Powder
